newsitem.title: ITALY: POLL-Italy seen auctioning 5.0 trln lire Btps.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Italy seen auctioning 5.0 trln lire Btps.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected to issue a total of some 5.0 trillion lire worth of medium and long-term fixed rate bonds (Btp) at its next auction on July 15, analysts polled by Reuters said.

The Treasury has said it will offer a ninth tranche of May 15, 2000 Btps with a 6.0 percent coupon, a seventh tranche of May 15, 2002 Btps with a 6.25 percent coupon and an 11th tranche of the 7.25 percent November 1, 2026 Btp.
The Treasury will announce the amount of paper on offer on Thursday.
Analysts forecast a fairly modest amount of paper to be offered given the favourable trend in state borrowing needs and the fact that no government securities are maturing.
